item.title: Loved
item.author: test@example.com (Web Author)
item.description:
Loved

A place to be heard, supported, encouraged, and reminded that you are never alone.

At New Birth of Believers Ministry, we believe that every person matters. We seek to create a loving and welcoming community where people can find someone to listen, receive support in difficult seasons, and discover resources that encourage spiritual and personal growth.

Listening

Sometimes, people simply need someone who will listen.

We provide a safe and caring environment where individuals can share their experiences, concerns, questions, and challenges without feeling judged. Through pastoral conversations, prayer, and fellowship, we seek to listen with compassion and respond with the love of Christ.

Meet Us

Information about our regular worship services, Bible study, and prayer gatherings.

Schedule

Times and details for our regular ministry gatherings.

Sunday Worship Service

Our Sunday Worship Service is a time of heartfelt praise, worship, prayer, and the teaching of God’s Word. It is a wonderful opportunity for fellowship, spiritual growth, and encountering God’s presence.

“Let us not neglect our meeting together… but encourage one another.” — Hebrews 10:24–25

item.title: Serve
item.author: test@example.com (Web Author)
item.description:
Service to Our Community

At New Birth of Believers Ministry, we believe that the Gospel is not only something we proclaim—it is something we live. As followers of Christ, we are called to love, serve, encourage, and make a positive difference in the lives of those around us.

Jesus said:

“By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another.” — John 13:35

Our desire is to be a church that reaches beyond its walls and serves our community with compassion, humility, and the love of Christ. We believe that every believer has a role to play, and that our time, talents, resources, and spiritual gifts can be used to bless others and bring glory to God.
